Excerptide settings

Your dashboard connection is prefilled. Sign in with your dashboard email and password in the extension popup.

Zotero (optional)

Create a dedicated read-only Zotero API key with access to your personal library. Credentials stay in this browser profile; they are never saved to Supabase.

Excerptide reads supported webpages to restore your saved highlights. It uploads only passages you explicitly clip. Browser internal pages, built-in PDF viewers, and text inside frames are not supported in this version.
